title: Multi-owner multi-agent systems: census code and data
description: Data, codebooks and code for the census of accepted AI papers and the coded sample of agent deployments in the Perspective 'Multi-owner multi-agent systems: from better agents to the rules between them'. From the committed coded labels and stored query results, the repository regenerates every Supplementary Information number (LaTeX fragments in si/) and Fig. 2, checked from a clean clone by test_clean_clone.sh. Code under MIT; data, coded labels and codebooks under CC BY 4.0.
